name: resume-agent
description: Build a customizable resume website with a reusable AI chat widget, gateway, and MCP server.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @resume-agent/site
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @resume-agent/contracts && npm run build -w @resume-agent/profile && npm run build -w @resume-agent/widget && npm run build -w @resume-agent/mcp && npm run build -w @resume-agent/gateway && npm run build -w @resume-agent/runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @resume-agent/site
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @resume-agent/contracts && npm run test -w @resume-agent/profile && npm run test -w @resume-agent/widget && npm run test -w @resume-agent/mcp && npm run test -w @resume-agent/gateway && npm run test -w @resume-agent/runtime && npm run test -w @resume-agent/site
scripts.verify: npm run check:leaks && npm run check:boundaries && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:packages && npm run check:leaks:artifacts
